title: metais.pack/1
description: What metais pack prints with --json: the package it wrote, or with --dry-run would write (ADR-007 D7, ADR-008 D9). With --out - the document is on standard error, after the package's bytes on standard output.

dry_run.description: Whether --dry-run was given, so that nothing was written.

file.description: The package file's name, <name>-<version>.metais, when pack chose it: without --out, or with an --out naming an existing directory; - when the package went to standard output. Absent when the caller named the file, whose path is never echoed.

size.description: The package file's size in bytes.

digest.description: The package digest: sha256: and 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

entries.description: The number of entries the package holds, .compiled/'s included.
